endangerment.comment: Achang (acn-NOCODE_Ngochang) = 7 (Shifting). Language of recognized nationality: Achang.

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The Achang [acn] entry in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 subsumes varieties which are not mutually intelligible (**hh:soc:Xiong:Achang**:212). Consequently, Ngochang merits a separate language entry. See also: Longchuan Achang [acn].
